about: Pairs (new, old) for the correction-hint rule (src/correction.rs). "correction": true = the new text corrects the old memory. Hits are cue + numeric value + same subject; misses are true corrections the rule is designed to skip (no numeric value, or no cue). Controls are near misses: build/version/year/id numbers, different subjects, same number without a cue.
